author: K Harry McElroy
text: I had three quit working when I first started using the system 3 years ago. They have gotten more reliable over time. One quit working about a year ago but reactivated when I pushed start new sensor. Really appreciate  the system overall.

author: Linda Sue
text: I've been using the Libre 3 and 3+ four the last 4 years... and have only had 3 devices fail on me.  Granted, two have been within the last couple of months; but since I have had no issues in getting them replaced, I'm not yet overly concerned.
